lines.zh: 我两只小脚啪嗒啪嗒地走
lines.en: My little feet patter along
My big ears sway as I go
The forest is dark, my eyes are bright
I go quickly, my legs are short
I kick stones as I walk
Pine needles prick my feet, I ignore them
I shake the horns on my shoulders
I run two steps and look back

lines.zh: 林子里什么都有，我不怕
lines.en: There is everything in this forest, I fear nothing
I am looking for something to play with
I bounce along, my temper shows
When I walk, the leaves sound
I squat on a root rubbing my hands

lines.zh: 我这副样子，别人看不上
lines.en: Looking like this, nobody thinks much of me

lines.zh: 火苗在我指尖跳了一下
lines.en: A flame jumps on my fingertip
I look up, the trees are too tall

lines.zh: 我踢了一脚地上的松果
lines.en: I kick a pinecone on the ground

lines.zh: 别看我这小个子，我能打
lines.en: Small as I am, I can fight
There is a little temper in me
When the wind comes, my ears twitch
I sit on a branch swinging my feet
I snort, quite unwilling
A bird is calling far off, so noisy

lines.zh: 我把手指在裤子上擦干净
lines.en: I wipe my fingers on my trousers

lines.zh: 我把手指擦了擦，还是脏
lines.en: I wipe my fingers, still dirty
My tail tip never stops moving

lines.zh: 林子里太闷，我喘了口粗气
lines.en: The forest is stuffy, I puff out a breath

lines.zh: 我想找个对手，今天还没有
lines.en: I want a fight, and none today
Small as I am, my fire isn't.
I look up until my neck aches
What do you want, say it

lines.zh: 我这两只手，放的不是好地方
lines.en: These two hands of mine are not kept in good places
Do not laugh at the way I look

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑森林里能发光
lines.en: My eyes glow in the black forest

lines.zh: 你身上有东西，我看到了
lines.en: You have something on you, I saw it

lines.zh: 我先看看，你是不是来打架的
lines.en: Let me see whether you came to fight

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，影子正好盖住我
lines.en: Standing there, your shadow covers me

lines.zh: 我退了一步，是给你面子
lines.en: I stepped back, that is courtesy
I was here first
Do not expect me to fear you
I grin and show two pointed teeth.
Do you want to see my fire
One turn and my mind has changed

lines.zh: 你还没说话，我就等烦了
lines.en: You have not spoken and I am already tired of waiting
I hopped with the pain
That took my footing
I cover the wound and glare at you
Small as I am, I hold grudges
I stepped back, and I am still mouthing off
One of my legs is shaking
It hurts, and I will not cry out
You hit me, I remember
This is not much to me
Again, I am not serious yet
That in your hand, is it for me
I reach out, then pull back
This is not something I refuse easily
Put it on the ground, I will get it
I take it, and I will not thank you
This smells better than pinecones
You think this is enough to buy me off?
I eat quickly, do not watch

lines.zh: 这东西太小，我一个人都不够
lines.en: This is too little even for one of me
You offer this. What do you want back?

lines.zh: 我觉得这比松果强多了。
lines.en: This beats pinecones by a mile.

lines.zh: 你手举那么高，我够不着
lines.en: Held that high, I cannot reach
You bumped me and I jumped clear at once

lines.zh: 我这小身板，撞一下就倒
lines.en: This small frame topples at one hit
I am steady, do not try again

lines.zh: 这一下，我的耳朵被撞歪了
lines.en: That bent my ear
I slipped past your legs

lines.zh: 你脚步看不清，脚下有我
lines.en: You do not watch your step, and I am under it
I stepped back, and I am still glaring

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的脾气上来了
lines.en: That brought my temper up
I am under the tree, you are on it? No
Touch me once more and see
Something like me, who would have it

lines.zh: 我脾气不好，自己也知道
lines.en: I know my own temper is bad
There are not many of my kind in this forest
Do not come too close, I get annoyed

lines.zh: 我想先把这地方管起来
lines.en: I want to take charge of this place first

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我又没说什么
lines.en: What are you laughing at, I said nothing

lines.zh: 我手上这点火，不是给人看的
lines.en: This fire in my hand is not for show
Don't get cozy with me. Beat it.

lines.zh: 我坐在树上想了一会儿
lines.en: I sat on the branch and thought a while
Forget it, say no more
I pick it up and stuff it in my pocket
Not too big, just right
I turn it over twice to look.

lines.zh: 这点分量，我一只手就行。
lines.en: This weight, one hand is plenty.
I look at it, I do not know it
Will this burn
I light it and it smokes
I dropped it fast
It burned my hand
This belongs to me now
I heard you, do not play dumb
I jump down from the tree
This place is mine, you took a wrong turn

lines.zh: 火苗从我指缝里蹿出来。
lines.en: Flame licks out between my fingers.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，我比你看得清
lines.en: In the black forest I see better than you

lines.zh: 你身上那点胆量，我看见了
lines.en: I see how little nerve you have
I grin, my teeth are uneven
One kick off my heels and I bolt.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在这林子里很响
lines.en: Your footsteps are loud in this forest
I come step by step, slowly

lines.zh: 我的耳朵竖着，一直在听
lines.en: My ears are up, always listening

lines.zh: 现在我反倒想看看你能干什么
lines.en: Now I want to see what you can do
I follow you, hidden behind trees

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我就从另一边出来
lines.en: You turn, and I come out the other side
I know this forest well

lines.zh: 我两只脚跑得比你想象快
lines.en: These two feet run faster than you think
I am not far behind you

lines.zh: 火光在林子里一闪一闪
lines.en: The firelight flickers in the forest
You are running deeper into the woods

lines.zh: 我在这片林子里混大的。
lines.en: I grew up in this stretch of woods.
I am in no hurry, I wait for you to tire

lines.zh: 前面那棵倒木，你过不去
lines.en: You will not get past that fallen trunk
I chase and laugh

lines.zh: 我踩着树枝跟在你上头。
lines.en: I follow along the branches above you.
I dart up and snatch

lines.zh: 我的火光擦过你的衣角。
lines.en: Firelight grazes the hem of your coat.
You were burnt and stepped back
I kick your knee
This small, and not weak

lines.zh: 我从你脚下钻过去，打你后背
lines.en: I slip under you and strike your back
You raise a hand, and I have dodged
That singed your trouser leg
I pull back half a step to come again
Do not look down on this little body
I rake a claw across your leg.
This punch is all the strength I have

lines.zh: 黑森林里多了一双亮眼睛
lines.en: A pair of bright eyes in the black forest
I hop out from behind a root
A small shadow has joined the forest
I land with a small sound

lines.zh: 我蹲在树根上，先看一圈。
lines.en: I squat on a root and look around first.
I push out of a pile of pine needles.
It is dark here, good for hiding me
I look up and take a look around
The flame on my hand flared once
I called first, nobody answered

lines.zh: 这一片林子，从今天归我踩
lines.en: This stretch of forest is mine to tread from today

lines.zh: 我从树上跳下来，落在叶子中间
lines.en: I jump down and land among the leaves
Fire does not scare me, I carry it

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，摔得直翻
lines.en: I fell from the tree and tumbled

lines.zh: 水把我身上的火浇灭了
lines.en: The water put out the fire on me
The blast rolled me far

lines.zh: 一支箭把我钉在树干上
lines.en: An arrow pinned me to the trunk

lines.zh: 那股劲儿让我手上的火灭了
lines.en: That force snuffed the flame in my hand

lines.zh: 林子里找不到吃的，我饿得发昏
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the forest, hunger makes me dizzy

lines.zh: 雷打得近，我耳朵嗡嗡响
lines.en: The lightning was close, my ears ring

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我踩不到东西
lines.en: No ground here, I cannot find footing
